It is truly heartwarming to witness the cinematic genius that convinces us high school is less of a bureaucratic nightmare and more of a Broadway audition. In this brave new world, the crushing weight of college applications and social anxiety are neatly resolved by a well-timed hip-hop routine. Why engage in the tedious, messy work of actual communication when you can simply out-choreograph your trauma? It is a marvel of modern storytelling that complex human emotions can be distilled into a perfectly synchronized dance-off, proving that if you just move your limbs with enough confidence, your parents will finally understand your feelings.

As for the primary material of a candle, it is typically wax, often derived from paraffin, beeswax, or soy, which serves as the fuel source that allows the wick to burn and produce light.
